excerpts.content: I have a proposal that I don't know if it's only for CL devs or both layers. We should get a unified metric that will help actually gather data from running nodes on reorgs and range syncing. We should deploy this as soon as possible and then monitor after the new P2P changes hit in. I think this will help to gather some data and even under adversarial scenario on devnets
